svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two lengths of 1044 mm; edges eased. Square the top end;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: round the foot end to a 22 mm radius about its hole (clears the ground).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 10.5 mm holes through the side, 22 mm from each end:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1000 mm between centres. Drill both props clamped together.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top: an M10 x 120 stainless bolt through the prop, the prop block

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and the side wall (nut and washer inside the wall).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Foot: lies against the outside face of the ground rail; an M10

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: x 100 stainless bolt with a wing nut through the prop and the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rail hole for the tilt you want (the stand pins).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: To change the tilt: support the panel, pull both foot pins, swing

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the props to the new holes, refit the pins.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: hole centres 1,000 mm apart within 1 mm.
